findings.note: Worktree-mode 'fresh path' set disagrees with the harness for a tracked file deleted from the working tree but still in the index (plain rm, not git rm). worktree.Paths() lists `git ls-files -c` entries without filtering absent ones (an Lstat error is not skipped), and changedPaths adds any unattested non-mutate/test path as changed with digest `absent`; the harness lists the same path but skips it (digestOf null), so it is never attested. Result: if the deleted file is support/global/unclassified (e.g. an old tests/helpers file or an un-ignored doc), task-done (and pr-ready --include-working-tree) report every kill stale with cause <path>=absent, and the recommended fix 're-run the harness' can never clear it until the deletion is staged or committed. Spec 6.3 says 'present paths not in files', so absent fresh paths should be skipped (e.g. `if !attested && digest == Absent { continue }`). Not blocking: task-done is always advisory, epic-ready already blocks dirty trees, and pr-ready defaults to HEAD mode where ls-tree lists only present paths; the only enforced path is the opt-in --include-working-tree + enforce combination. Carried forward unchanged from plan edeacff8273fa5e4: commit 288482f touched only content.go's internal variable naming and did not touch classify.go, snapshot.mjs, or the design doc, so this finding still applies as-is; already scheduled for the next plan.
